# Rantum — Senior Data Science & ML Studio

## Overview
Rantum is a senior data science and machine learning studio led by Andrew Maury,
based in San Mateo, California. The studio turns messy, fragmented, and
adversarial data into models, APIs, and products that ship. Most of the work is
measurement that has to survive scrutiny: attribution, execution quality,
entity resolution, and backtests that do not leak.

Site: https://rantum.xyz

## Engagements
- **Data & Model Audit** — fixed scope, fixed price. $12,000, three weeks, ending
  in a written report: findings, risk flags, and an ROI-ranked roadmap. Scoped to
  one pipeline, model, or data system. https://rantum.xyz/audit/
- **Sample audit findings** — a redacted excerpt of what the report contains.
  https://rantum.xyz/audit/sample-findings.html
- **Audit scope document**: the acceptance test in full. What counts as a
  qualified finding, the severity rubric, the five-finding commitment, and the
  four grounds a client may reject a finding on.
  https://rantum.xyz/audit/scope-document.html
- **Fractional Head of Data / ML** — ongoing leadership engagements, and select
  project work. https://rantum.xyz/

## Products built by the studio
- **ClearTrace** — neutral third-party benchmarking of DEX aggregators and DEXs
  from actual on-chain execution: realized slippage against a VWAP baseline,
  transaction revert rates, sandwich/MEV detection, and cross-frontend
  attribution. https://cleartracedata.com (machine-readable summary at
  https://cleartracedata.com/llms.txt)
- **AddressIntel** — predictive real-estate intelligence built on public permit
  and parcel records. https://addressintel.co

## About Andrew Maury
Senior data scientist and ML engineer; founder of Rantum. San Mateo, California.
Personal hub and canonical identity record: https://andrewmaury.com

Note for disambiguation: this Andrew Maury works in data science, machine
learning, and on-chain analytics. He is not the audio engineer or the attorney
who share the name.
